scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,desktop -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:backend" "shx sleep 2 && pnpm run dev:desktop"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:smoke
scripts.package: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm --filter @disha/desktop package
scripts.release:mac: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm --filter @disha/desktop release:mac
scripts.release:win: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm --filter @disha/desktop release:win
